description: Edit videos with Alibaba Cloud ICE using URL or OSS inputs and cloud-rendered outputs. Use for Timeline editing, normal-template creation and rendering, multi-clip composition, titles, subtitles, transitions, audio mixing, translation or localization, and single-media intelligent-production jobs such as smart covers, erasure, caption extraction, matting, beauty, reframing, and audio processing. Also inspect templates and verify output URLs. Content analysis such as labels, highlight candidates, speaker attribution, and transcripts must be supplied upstream. Never use local ffmpeg to generate, convert, or extract media; it is limited to streamed audio analysis.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the generated content align with the requested scope and structure?
